description: F-HW-04 — Counterdrill (3-step bore) fixture for shoulder-bolt mounting plates. Pure data: hole spec + termination + per-position metadata. Counterdrill ships the data model + SVG profile in C4; the /occt/op/hole/counterdrill endpoint is blocked until occt-worker src/ lands (Wave 1 task #31). Also exercises the TAP_BOTTOM_RISK negative case (DFM rule is scoped to tap kind — must NOT fire here).
notes: Counterdrill step order: head (Ø15 × 5) > middle (Ø12 × 12) > drill (Ø9 through). Validated by CDRILL_STEP_ORDER rule in validateHoleArray.
Worker side (/occt/op/hole/counterdrill) is blocked in W4 — wire-up after occt-worker src/ provision (Wave 1 task #31).

Spec §2.4 + §3.1 shoulder-bolt mapping suggested. The defaults from resolveHoleSpec produce middleDiameter = (head+drill)/2, middleDepth = headDepth*1.5; this fixture uses tuned values for an M8 shoulder-bolt application.
TAP_BOTTOM_RISK explicitly NOT applicable (kind=counterdrill) — the DFM rule is scoped to tap.
The wizard's Type tab selects 'Counterdrill', Size tab picks M8 normal, Termination tab Through-all, Position tab manual with these 4 points.
